definitions.explanation: The quality of being concrete, tangible, or having a specific form, as opposed to being abstract or conceptual.
In art, refers to representational or figurative work that depicts recognizable subjects, as opposed to abstract art.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{具|ぐ}→具：07857_gu⟧ (tool, means, to be furnished with) and {象|しょう} (image, form). The word contrasts directly with ⟦{抽象|ちゅうしょう}→抽象：08670_chuushou⟧ (abstract). Can function as a noun or as the stem for the na-adjective {具象|ぐしょう}⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {具象|ぐしょう}⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧: concrete, tangible (adjectival form)
- {具象|ぐしょう}⟦{化|か}→〜化：28335_ka⟧: concretization, making concrete
- {具象|ぐしょう}{画|が}: representational painting
- {具象|ぐしょう}⟦{彫刻|ちょうこく}→彫刻：04448_choukoku⟧: figurative sculpture
- {具象|ぐしょう}⟦{表現|ひょうげん}→表現：03584_hyougen⟧: concrete expression

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{具体|ぐたい}→具体：02675_gutai⟧: concrete, specific — more common in everyday usage; {具象|ぐしょう} is more literary and art-related
- ⟦{抽象|ちゅうしょう}→抽象：08670_chuushou⟧: abstract — the direct opposite
- ⟦{写実|しゃじつ}→写実：20133_shajitsu⟧: realism — in art, focuses on faithful depiction; overlaps with {具象|ぐしょう} but emphasizes accuracy
